entries.name: 罗马哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Roman forum panorama, whole monumental domes/porticoes/statues, surrounding city and mountains, small everyday figures in the square, existing warm sunlit atmosphere and complete foreground balustrade/steps. Preserve architecture as main subject; no added large philosopher portraits.

entries.name: 两汉经学
entries.recognitionCue: Academy veranda and its columns, foreground bamboo-slip manuscripts, bamboo/wood book containers and full desks; scholars collating/reading/commenting with distinct gestures, wider academy courtyard, everyday pedestrians, river town, mountain depth. Keep actual classical text study within civic daily life, no giant labels, extra portrait or change of era.

entries.name: 拜占庭哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Luminous imperial coastal city, whole prominent domed church, walls, courtyards and port with many small ships; sunset golden water, tall cypresses and far islands, complete foreground colonnade and balcony. Retain quiet environment-focused composition, no extra figures or invented symbols.
